paths.description: Homepage and recent-content browse template; covers navigation, search entry, preferences, performance, accessibility and responsive layout.
Movie listing/index archetype with pagination and image grid; represents catalog listing pages.

Movie detail/watch archetype; covers content detail, embedded player surface, third-party media and mobile reflow. Playback and outbound direct-link destinations were not activated to avoid unnecessary third-party execution.
Primary search interaction using “mummy”; covers dynamic results and repeated-interaction memory behaviour.
Representative nonexistent route and crawler/no-JavaScript view; covers HTTP recovery and progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: The interface is fixed to a light palette.
findings.evidence: The preferences screenshot is pixel-identical to the normal capture while prefers-color-scheme: dark is active; computed body background remains transparent and the white cards/navigation do not retint.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, control and browser-UI colors.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference does not improve already weak control contrast.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-contrast: more the page remains unchanged, while axe reports 2.53:1 on the search control and 3.63:1 on media badges.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast styles and preserve visible borders, text and focus indicators.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no View Transition usage; navigation and injected search/list state swap instantly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document and cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for meaningful state and route changes.

findings.summary: Long catalog pages provide no scroll-state cue or persistent orientation.
findings.evidence: The 2,213px mobile homepage has static, non-sticky navigation and no progress or scrolled-state treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact sticky header or scroll-state-aware cue without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is tied only to viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: Captured CSS uses @media min-width rules and fixed percentages but no container queries, despite cards/components appearing in multiple-width contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type and size-aware component rules where catalog and detail components are reused.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch target support are weak.
findings.evidence: CSS globally sets a { outline: 0 }; many navigation/list links are only 30–36px high, below a comfortable touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore :focus-visible indicators and enlarge or space interactive targets to at least 44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: Search and failure states lack useful status and recovery messaging.
findings.evidence: Search injects results without a live status/loading announcement; a nonexistent route returns a bare nginx 404 with no route back or retry guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide visible and programmatically announced loading/empty/error states with retry, clear, and return-to-browse actions.

findings.summary: Essential text and controls fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse identify search text at 2.53:1, badges at 3.63:1, and an in-text link distinguishable only by weak color contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose tokens that meet WCAG AA in all states and underline links in prose.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks a main landmark, an H1, and robust focus styling.
findings.evidence: axe reports landmark-one-main, page-has-heading-one and region violations; authored CSS removes anchor outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Use header/nav/main/footer landmarks, add one descriptive H1, and preserve a logical visible focus sequence.

findings.summary: Body and metadata text are unusually small.
findings.evidence: Authored CSS uses 11px body text and 11–12px metadata/list labels across primary content, visible as cramped text in desktop and mobile captures.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt a readable base size and line-height, then scale secondary metadata without dropping below comfortable reading sizes.

findings.summary: Many controls are undersized for touch and the player exposes no caption evidence.
findings.evidence: Mobile captures show 30–36px tab/navigation targets; the embedded iframe surface provides no host-page track or transcript metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase touch target hit areas and ensure every media source exposes captions or an equivalent.

findings.summary: The homepage throws an uncaught runtime error.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse records TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading classList) at the homepage XHR callback.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard optional nodes before classList access and add regression coverage for asynchronous list updates.

findings.summary: Image markup omits intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found width/height attributes missing on all eight homepage images; layout is currently held by wrapper CSS rather than intrinsic metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height attributes matching source aspect ratios while retaining responsive CSS.

findings.summary: Public pages have empty meta descriptions.
findings.evidence: DOM captures show meta name="description" content="" on the homepage, listing and detail templates; Lighthouse fails meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Write unique, accurate descriptions for each archetype and item page.

findings.summary: Non-JavaScript crawler access is inconsistent and much content depends on XHR.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 39% raw/rendered word coverage; its no-JS browser screenshot received Cloudflare Error 1015 rate limiting while browser rendering succeeded.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the primary catalog content present in server HTML and tune bot/rate-limit policy so legitimate crawlers receive stable 200 responses.

findings.summary: Indexing support is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Canonical links exist, but /sitemap.xml returns 404 and robots.txt contains rights-reservation prose without a sitemap declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a current XML sitemap, reference it from robots.txt, and keep canonical/status signals consistent.

findings.summary: Detail pages lack structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The movie detail DOM contains visible title, duration, genre, date, description and cast but no JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org Movie JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but core browser defenses and cookie attributes are weak.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence reports no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; one first-party cookie lacks Secure/HttpOnly and both cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and least-privilege cookie attributes.

findings.summary: The detail page eagerly embeds third-party streaming code without an explicit privacy boundary.
findings.evidence: The detail DOM immediately loads a wootly.ch iframe and script before playback intent; the homepage HAR already attributes 86% of bytes to another origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer media/third-party execution until user intent, isolate it with iframe sandbox/allow controls, and disclose the provider/data transfer.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are mostly absent.
findings.evidence: Only X-Frame-Options is present; HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an explicit defense-in-depth header policy and validate embedded-media exceptions narrowly.

findings.summary: Primary current-content coverage degrades without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Only 39% of rendered content words occur in raw HTML and the crawler screenshot was replaced by Cloudflare Error 1015; recent results are XHR-injected.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the primary list/search fallback and ensure a useful no-JS response before enhancement.

findings.summary: An asynchronous list callback assumes missing DOM state.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured an uncaught classList access in the XHR callback, demonstrating fragile runtime state handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat optional elements defensively and make async completion idempotent and cancel-safe.

findings.summary: HTTP failure handling falls through to a generic server page.
findings.evidence: A representative missing route returns a bare nginx 404 with no branded explanation, search, retry or path back.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a useful site-level 404 and surface actionable retry/fallback UI for failed XHR and media loads.

findings.summary: The document does not declare its language and uses physical-direction CSS.
findings.evidence: All captured templates have html lang=null; CSS extensively uses left/right padding and positioning rather than logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct lang/dir and migrate layout rules to inline/block logical properties.

findings.summary: Visible dates and durations are hard-coded English strings.
findings.evidence: Detail markup renders “133min” and “April 2026” directly with no locale metadata or alternate formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Represent machine-readable values and format duration/date output with Intl for the active locale.

findings.summary: Search input assistance is underspecified.
findings.evidence: The primary search input has placeholder text but no name, label, autocomplete or search input type.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type="search", an explicit label/name, and an appropriate autocomplete policy.

findings.summary: Catalog images use only legacy formats and no responsive source selection.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found eight legacy JPG/GIF assets, no modern formats, no srcset, and no intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants with responsive srcset/sizes and intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party media is loaded before playback intent.
findings.evidence: The detail template eagerly creates a cross-origin player iframe and remote script on initial load rather than using a poster and click-to-load boundary.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a lightweight poster first and create the sandboxed player only after explicit playback intent.

taskList.title: Restore accessible structure, focus, target sizing and contrast
Deploy security headers, strict cookies and a deferred sandboxed media boundary
Server-render primary content and provide useful crawler/no-JS/error responses
Add complete discovery metadata and sitemap support
Declare language and localise date/duration rendering
Harden async list code and visible recovery states
Improve responsive component and input semantics
Add measured route/state transitions and scroll orientation
